EXPLANATORY MEMORANDUM
This Act repeals the Insurance Act 1997 and enacts a new Insurance Act, which
provides among other things, for
(a) an increase in the paid-up share capital of insurance companies ;
(b)classification of insurance business into life insurance business
and general insurance business ; and
(c) better supervision and control of the insurance industry in
Nigeria.
